in_hebrew.name: Kim
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kim הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Korean word ‘ki’ meaning gold and ‘im’ meaning sleepless or weak, Kim may symbolize a person who is precious and valuable despite their weaknesses. In biblical context, the name may be associated with King Kimbri, a biblical figure mentioned in the book of Ezra.
